2608.14130.title: AlignFace: Human-Aligned Face Similarity Metric with Interpretable Concept Relations
2608.14130.paper_summary: Computer vision models for generated facial content, such as face editing and privacy protection, increasingly affect people, requiring similarity metrics that serve as faithful proxies for human perception. While perceptual evaluation has progressed from signal-based heuristics to representation-based metrics, current approaches are limited to behavioral modeling without cognitive alignment. They rely on implicit and spurious relations while assuming a universal observer, failing to account for inherent variations across diverse human populations. This leads to inaccurate evaluative models of stakeholders and misleading guidance for generative model debugging. Rather than treating perception as a black box, we leverage scientific findings from cognitive psychology of human face similarity perception: dependence on facial featural and configural attributes, nonlinear psychophysical response scaling, and own-group biases. We introduce the FACETS dataset and propose AlignFace, an interpretable, human-aligned, face similarity metric that encodes these cognitive principles through ante-hoc modeling. It employs visual-language modeling (VLM) to encode paired face images and text-based attributes, gated cross-attention (CA) to extract attribute-specific facial difference representations, concept bottleneck modeling (CBM) to constrain reasoning via interpretable face attributes, and neural generalized additive model (GAM) to model their nonlinear influence. Experiments found AlignFace significantly improves alignment with human subpopulation perceptions compared to baseline metrics, including recent domain-free learned perceptual metrics. By bridging learned representations and human cognitive processes, this work enables more transparent and aligned perceptual evaluation metrics for face images.
2608.14130.paper_summary_zh: 電腦視覺模型用於生成的面部內容，例如面部編輯和隱私保護，越來越影響人們，這需要作為人類感知的忠實代理的相似性度量。雖然感知評估已從基於信號的啟發式方法進展到基於表徵的度量，但當前的方法僅限於行為建模，缺乏認知對齊。它們依賴於隱性和虛假的關係，同時假設一個普遍的觀察者，未能考慮到不同人群之間固有的變異性。這導致了對利益相關者的不準確評估模型，並為生成模型調試提供了誤導性的指導。我們不將感知視為黑箱，而是利用來自人類面部相似性感知的認知心理學的科學發現：對面部特徵和配置屬性的依賴、非線性心理物理反應縮放以及自群體偏見。我們介紹了FACETS數據集並提出AlignFace，一種可解釋的、人類對齊的面部相似性度量，通過事前建模編碼這些認知原則。它使用視覺-語言建模（VLM）來編碼成對的面部圖像和基於文本的屬性，使用門控交叉注意力（CA）來提取屬性特定的面部差異表示，使用概念瓶頸建模（CBM）來通過可解釋的面部屬性限制推理，並使用神經廣義加法模型（GAM）來建模它們的非線性影響。實驗發現，與基線度量相比，AlignFace顯著改善了與人類子群體感知的對齊，包括最近的無領域學習的感知度量。通過橋接學習的表徵和人類認知過程，這項工作使得面部圖像的感知評估度量更加透明和對齊。
